## Tasks


## Task 1

The following command returns the path to a tif file on your hard drive:


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code  code-fold="false"}
system.file("ex/elev.tif", package="terra")
```
:::

   
Use this path to import the tif file using `rast()`, store it as `r`. It contains the elevation of Luxembourg.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library("terra")
r <- system.file("ex/elev.tif", package="terra") |> 
   rast()
```
:::


## Task 2

Calculate the (global) mean, maximum and minimum elevation values.



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
global(r, c("mean","max","min"), na.rm = TRUE)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
              mean max min
elevation 348.3366 547 141
```


:::
:::


## Task 3

Calculate slope and aspect (see [terrain functions](https://rspatial.github.io/terra/reference/terrain.html))


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
r_slope <- terrain(r, "slope")
r_aspect <- terrain(r, "aspect")
```
:::


## Task 4

Determine suitable locations of solar panels using the following conditions:

   - Elevation: above 300 MASL
   - Slope: Between 1 and 3° 
   - Aspect: Southfacing (between 135 and 235°)



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
good_elev <- r > 300
good_slope <- r_slope > 1 & r_slope <= 3
good_aspect <- r_aspect > 135 & r_aspect <= 235

good <- good_elev & good_slope & good_aspect

plot(good, main = "Solar panel suitability")
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](lesson2-tasks_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-5-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::





## Task 5

Reclassify the elevation raster into three categories using `classify()`:

- *Low*: below the 33rd percentile
- *Mid*: between the 33rd and 66th percentile
- *High*: above the 66th percentile

Use `global()` with `quantile` to compute the cut points.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
cuts <- global(r, quantile, probs = c(0, .33, .66, 1), na.rm = TRUE)
r_class <- classify(r, as.numeric(cuts))
levels(r_class) <- data.frame(ID = 0:2, category = c("low", "mid", "high"))
plot(r_class)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](lesson2-tasks_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-6-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::



## Task 6

Import the municipalities of Luxembourg and calculate the minimum, maximum, and mean elevation per municipality. Then visualize the mean elevation per municipality as a map.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(tmap)
lux <- system.file("ex/lux.shp", package="terra") |>
  vect()
zones <- rasterize(lux, r, "NAME_2")
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
mean_vals <- zonal(r, zones, fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
min_vals  <- zonal(r, zones, fun = min,  na.rm = TRUE)
max_vals  <- zonal(r, zones, fun = max,  na.rm = TRUE)

mean_vals2 <- mean_vals |>
  dplyr::mutate(ID = dplyr::row_number() - 1, .before = 0) |>
  dplyr::select(-NAME_2)
zones_mean <- classify(as.int(zones), mean_vals2)

tm_shape(zones_mean) +
  tm_raster(style = "cont", palette = "viridis", title = "Mean Elevation (m)") +
  tm_layout(legend.outside = TRUE)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](lesson2-tasks_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-8-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::



## Task 7

Smooth the elevation raster using a 3×3 and an 11×11 mean focal window. Compare the two results visually side by side.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
w3  <- matrix(rep(1, 9),   ncol = 3)
w11 <- matrix(rep(1, 121), ncol = 11)
r_smooth3  <- focal(r, w3,  fun = mean, fillNA = TRUE)
r_smooth11 <- focal(r, w11, fun = mean, fillNA = TRUE)
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot(r_smooth3,  main = "3x3 focal mean")
plot(r_smooth11, main = "11x11 focal mean")
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](lesson2-tasks_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-9-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::



## Task 8

Reproject the elevation raster to EPSG:2169 (Luxembourg national grid, units: metres) and resample to 1 km resolution. Then apply a circular focal filter with a 5 km radius using `focalMat()`.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
r_proj <- project(r, "EPSG:2169")
template <- rast(res = 1000, ext = ext(r_proj))
r_1km <- resample(r_proj, template)
w_circle <- focalMat(r_1km, d = 5000, type = "circle")
r_circle <- focal(r_1km, w_circle, fun = sum, na.rm = TRUE)
plot(r_circle, main = "5 km circular mean elevation")
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](lesson2-tasks_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-10-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::



## Task 9

Import the multispectral Landsat 7 image as a raster:


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
system.file("tif/L7_ETMs.tif", package = "stars")
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
l7 <- system.file("tif/L7_ETMs.tif", package = "stars") |>
  rast()
```
:::



## Task 10

Calculate the [NDVI](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Normalized_difference_vegetation_index) using the formula below and visualize the result with a diverging color scale centered at 0.

$$\text{NDVI} = \frac{\text{NIR}-\text{red}}{\text{NIR}+\text{red}}$$


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
names(l7) <- c("B", "G", "R", "NIR", "SWIR", "MIR")
NDVI <- (l7[["NIR"]] - l7[["R"]]) / (l7[["NIR"]] + l7[["R"]])
library(tmap)
tm_shape(NDVI) +
  tm_raster(style = "cont", title = "NDVI", midpoint = 0, breaks = c(-1, 0, 1)) +
  tm_layout(legend.outside = TRUE)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](lesson2-tasks_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-13-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::
